title: I truly can’t stop thinking about @Phantom Peak London UK - one of my...
transcript: This might be the most fun theatrical experience I've ever had. Join me for an experience I really. I could not tell you what it is. I'm in London on a theater trip, and my friend Ben has become obsessed with this thing called Phantom Peak. It looks like it's an Old West town immersive theater experience. Something I don't know, but I'm about to find out. Oh, there they are! I'm so excited. Theme park, real life video game, escape room, immersive theater all in one. Honestly, though, that's a pretty good representation of what Phantom Peak actually is. Phantom Peak is essentially an open world game. You get to explore an entire town with shops and saloons and characters. The place is massive, indoors, outdoors. And while you're there, there are tons of quests and side quests you can choose to partake in. Sometimes you play games to earn tokens for your team, but you can also help solve mysteries and go on adventure. We did two different character missions and both were pretty in depth. lots of fun riddles to solve and games to play and people to talk to. One of them even involved a very cool maze. There literally feels like there are, I don't know, 25 different quests, maybe more, because even though it's busy and occasionally there are other people on the same quest as you, never felt like there were too many people doing the same thing at the same time. Good for all ages and is super adaptable depending on any kind of group. Cause it's entirely dependent on you and what you want to do. And honestly, I wanna go back because every season they revamp it and I wanna see what they do for the next one. We also made an award winning film if you wanna see it. It was a blast. It was insane, like truly so much fun. I'm obsessed with it. I'm going back. Thanks, Ben. Thanks, Ben. It's so good.
classificationReason: This is about an immersive theater/theme park experience in London that is not in the provided list of Broadway/West End productions
